baselineFindings.summary: archiveSession in electron/services/sessions-api.ts renames the transcript and updates the archive index without acquiring the runtime session admission fence or requiring an idle run.
restoreSession removes the archive-index entry before restoring the archived transcript; a crash can leave no retry locator.
The actual Chat store is src/stores/chat.ts. Same-named helpers under src/stores/chat/ are not accepted as production callers unless the actual store composition or a test proves the edge.
Live delete already persists a caller operationId, requires a matching runtime_committed receipt, closes the terminal and only then sweeps the local mirror.
Handoff creation is serialized and creates a new draft child session; it does not mutate the source or transfer task/goal ownership.

limitations: No live backend, Gateway restart, Electron E2E, permission revocation or long-running resource test was executed for A1.
No Project store, second task/goal authority, universal resource table or scheduler is introduced.
Archive/restore remain partial until TF-0549 lands the lifecycle barrier.
All evidence is agent-driven; no real-human claim is made.
